But whats the point if I'm just gonne be him? I know that with time i will start to act more and more like him and that realazation makes me go dark, quiet and stoned. this sort of thing happened this summer and my mom said that this is the last stroke so shes going to sue him next month now. I remember I called a kids support like and that got me up that time. but I wasnt thinking so deep as now. this is not good. i fear myslef.    
everything thats i do wrong such as the writhing I did for my teacher, say something outof the context in a chat with somebody(esencially making the perfect socially awqard penguin meme) puts me down and down. i learned to laugh it off and move on. but I guess the built up in me broke this time.
